label: GDP per capita, PPP
note: Individual-level prosperity: wages, prices, standard of living.

label: GDP, PPP
note: Market size: how much economic activity the door opens onto.

label: Trade
note: How externally engaged the economy is; proxies ease of doing business as a foreigner.

label: Human Development Index
note: UNDP composite of life expectancy, education, and income.

label: Individuals using the internet
note: Digital infrastructure; the binding constraint for remote work.

label: Tertiary school enrolment
note: Higher-education capacity; proxies value as a study destination.

label: Surface area
note: Physical extent: how much there is to actually go and see.

label: International tourist arrivals
note: Revealed preference: where the world actually chooses to go.

label: International tourism receipts
note: Value, not just volume, of the tourism draw.

label: Registered carrier departures
note: Air connectivity. A visa waiver you cannot fly to is theoretical.

label: Rule of law index (V-Dem)
note: Are laws applied predictably and impartially to a foreigner?

label: Electoral democracy index (V-Dem)
note: Civil-liberties environment a visitor is subject to.

label: Intentional homicides
note: Physical safety. Log-scaled: the gap from 1 to 10 per 100k matters more than 40 to 50.

label: Price level (PPP-to-market exchange-rate ratio)
note: Cost of being there, relative to the world average.
